title: BNPL Management Dashboard: Tracking Overdue Plans and Due Dates
summary: This document explains the BNPL Management Dashboard widgets for tracking overdue plans and upcoming due dates, including the dashboard’s overdue plan count and the earliest upcoming installment due date (both shown as “[value not available]”). It also describes how overdue plans are visually highlighted when a setting “[value not available]” is true/false and suggests a review workflow using the overdue count and due date.
